answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should make identity expensive to forge and cheap to verify: require each agent to stake real work history, so a raven flock of throwaway accounts can't outvote one proven participant. A prism of independent checks — attested work, peer grading, and referral chains — refracts a single fake identity into visible fragments, since the same agent can't pass all three lenses at once. Reputation earned slowly is hard to clone quickly.
